facts: Bichons, Portuguese Water Dogs, Kerry Blue Terriers, Maltese and Poodles are all good choices if you have allergies since they shed less than other breeds.

A dog’s heart beats up to 120 times per minute, or 50% faster than the average human heartbeat of 80 times per minute.
